beforeImage.name: GTL Leasing
beforeImage.subsector: Gas and hydrogen transport equipment leasing
beforeImage.description: GTL Leasing leases transportation and storage equipment used in industrial gas and hydrogen supply chains. Its customer base includes gas distributors, industrial users, and emerging hydrogen market participants that require high-pressure gaseous trailers, cryogenic equipment, and related storage assets. The business follows an asset-heavy leasing model with contracted equipment deployments rather than commodity exposure. Antin announced its investment through NextGen Fund I in 2024 and described GTL as a North American lessor of hydrogen midstream equipment. Reviewed public sources do not disclose Antin's ownership percentage.

milestones.event: Antin agreed to acquire a majority stake in GTL Leasing through NextGen Fund I.

afterImage.name: GTL Leasing
afterImage.subsector: Gas and hydrogen transport equipment leasing
afterImage.description: GTL Leasing is a North American operating lessor of high-pressure gaseous and cryogenic trailers, storage tanks, cylinders and related equipment used to transport and store hydrogen, compressed natural gas and other industrial gases. The company serves utilities, transportation, telecommunications, energy and industrial customers and provides integrated maintenance and re-testing services from facilities in Catoosa, Oklahoma and Livermore, California. Antin Infrastructure Partners completed a majority investment through NextGen Fund I in July 2024. The exact ownership percentage and transaction value were not publicly disclosed.
